title: Dify #38522: guard KB deletion during active indexing
description:
Source issue: https://github.com/langgenius/dify/issues/38522

Repo: https://github.com/langgenius/dify

Task:
Fix or propose a robust implementation for preventing knowledge-base deletion while documents are still indexing. The issue suggests pausing/awaiting in-flight indexing before delete, or rejecting deletion with a clear error if indexing is active.

Deliverables:
- Review the issue and the affected dataset/indexing code paths.
- Implement a safe fix or a well-argued patch that closes the race.
- Include tests or a clear validation plan for the deletion/indexing scenario.
- Share the exact files changed and any operational caveats.

Acceptance criteria:
- The solution directly addresses issue #38522.
- Deleting a knowledge base no longer races active indexing work.
- The proposed behavior is clear, bounded, and maintainable.
- Include links or commit references for the work product.

Please mention issue #38522 in your application and summarize your proposed approach.
